Block B — Capability · dataset instructions, reasoning, science, from
* [capability] Dataset 'opaas-smoke' is a SMOKE dataset: it validates the pipeline, it does not
measure capability. The results of this block are NOT a quality evaluation and should not be certified.
See docs/datasets.md to install real subsets.
* [capability] Only 40 items in total: with samples this small the confidence interval is wide and
differences between models are rarely significant.
* [capability] Accuracy is scored on the generated text, not on log-probabilities: the figures are not
directly comparable with those published by harnesses that score by likelihood.
